person.p: the tag layer; a sentence written by the tagger about the paper, always anchored to a quotation but not itself a quotation

span.label: how areas across the entire mouse neocortex organise into communication networks, mapped by over 600 traced pathways
span.note: Quotation withheld because this record is not cleared for redistribution.

span.label: how do different cortical areas communicate at the network level across the whole structure
span.note: Quotation withheld because this record is not cleared for redistribution.

span.label: delivers a cortical connectivity atlas and matrices from uniformly collected tracer data, and finds the neocortex clusters into four somatic sensorimotor, two medial and two lateral subnetworks
span.note: Quotation withheld because this record is not cleared for redistribution.

span.label: each injection is designed to return four kinds of information at once - inputs, outputs, reciprocal connections and intermediate stations - by pairing an anterograde with a retrograde tracer
span.note: Quotation withheld because this record is not cleared for redistribution.

span.label: the two tracer directions are used as independent measurements of the same connection, and their agreement is reported as a validity check
span.note: Quotation withheld because this record is not cleared for redistribution.

span.label: injection specificity is cross-validated by tracing the reverse direction: retrograde tracer into the regions the anterograde labelling had targeted
span.note: Quotation withheld because this record is not cleared for redistribution.

span.label: the subnetworks are not stipulated but produced by reordering the matrix with a clustering algorithm, and named afterwards
span.note: Quotation withheld because this record is not cleared for redistribution.

span.label: the clustering makes the matrix diagonal readable as within-subnetwork density and the off-diagonal as between-subnetwork traffic
span.note: Quotation withheld because this record is not cleared for redistribution.

span.label: the whole analysis rests on hand annotation, because no tool can identify fine anatomic boundaries, and the strengths recorded are semi-quantitative
span.note: Quotation withheld because this record is not cleared for redistribution.

span.label: each pathway is rendered as a separate layer in a common anatomic frame so that arbitrary combinations can be viewed together
span.note: Quotation withheld because this record is not cleared for redistribution.

span.label: uniform collection and analysis is claimed as the advantage over connectivity matrices assembled from published literature
span.note: Quotation withheld because this record is not cleared for redistribution.

span.label: the somatosensory subdivisions used as network nodes are themselves validated against known somatotopy in the brainstem before being used
span.note: Quotation withheld because this record is not cleared for redistribution.

span.label: a visualisation artefact is disclosed rather than left for the reader to discover: the injection sites look larger than they are once the image is brightened enough to show fine fibers
span.note: Quotation withheld because this record is not cleared for redistribution.

span.label: the resource is framed as the input to later causal work, naming the specific techniques that would test any mapped pathway
span.note: Quotation withheld because this record is not cleared for redistribution.

span.label: Interpreting large-scale connectivity data remains an unsolved challenge.
span.note: what this limits: the interpretive claims, not the resource: the paper demonstrates THE FEASIBILITY OF PRODUCING AND COLLECTING LARGE-SCALE CONNECTIVITY DATA, and names interpretation as the unsolved part
Quotation withheld because this record is not cleared for redistribution.

span.label: Published injection-site images overstate the true injection size.
span.note: what this limits: any reading of injection extent from the published figures: WHEN IMAGES ARE ADJUSTED TO REVEAL FINE FIBERS, INJECTION [extent appears larger] than the ~250-500um stated
Quotation withheld because this record is not cleared for redistribution.

span.label: Annotation had to be done by hand because no automated tool can delineate fine anatomical boundaries.
span.note: what this limits: the precision of every areal boundary in the atlas: INFORMATICS TOOLS THAT AUTOMATICALLY AND PRECISELY IDENTIFY FINE ANATOMIC BOUNDARIES ... ARE NON-EXISTENT, so annotation is by hand
Quotation withheld because this record is not cleared for redistribution.

span.label: The mapped long-range interactions have not been validated at the synaptic or cell-type level.
span.note: what this limits: the synaptic and cell-type reading of any mapped connection: these MAY BE VALIDATED AT THE SYNAPTIC LEVEL USING TRANSSYNAPTIC VIRAL TRACING - not done here
Quotation withheld because this record is not cleared for redistribution.

span.label: interpreting connectivity data at this scale is named as the unsolved part, not the collection of it
span.note: what this limits: the same scope as item 0 - collection is demonstrated, interpretation is not
Quotation withheld because this record is not cleared for redistribution.

span.label: no automated tool exists for the annotation step, so the atlas is hand-made and semi-quantitative
span.note: what this limits: the same scope as item 2, with the consequence: the analysis is hand-made and semi-quantitative
Quotation withheld because this record is not cleared for redistribution.

span.label: the matrices discard route, laminar specificity and topography, which the authors call critical features of networks
span.note: what this limits: every use of the connectivity matrices: THEY EXCLUDE DETAILS LIKE PROJECTIONS ROUTES, LAMINAR SPECIFICITY OF PROJECTIONS, OR TOPOGRAPHICAL organisation - the condensed view drops features the authors call critical
Quotation withheld because this record is not cleared for redistribution.

span.label: the mapped connections are anatomical and require separate validation at the synaptic and functional level
span.note: what this limits: the same scope as item 3 - anatomical connections, awaiting synaptic and functional validation
Quotation withheld because this record is not cleared for redistribution.

span.label: human network findings are held to need validation in animal models at higher resolution, which is the gap this atlas is built to fill

span.label: The mouse neocortex resolves into eight subnetworks: four somatic sensorimotor, two medial and two lateral, each with its own topology, communicating through selected cortical areas.
span.note: Quotation withheld because this record is not cleared for redistribution.

span.label: Anterograde and retrograde tracing agreed on 89% of matrix entries, cross-validating the connectivity dataset.
span.note: Quotation withheld because this record is not cleared for redistribution.

span.label: The claustrum's cortical connectivity is asymmetric: it receives bilateral cortical input but sends output almost exclusively to the same hemisphere.
span.note: Quotation withheld because this record is not cleared for redistribution.

span.label: The temporal association, ectorhinal and perirhinal areas are back-labelled from layers 2 and 5a of the entire neocortex except ACAv, RSP and VISp, meaning this subnetwork collects input from nearly the whole cortex.
span.note: Quotation withheld because this record is not cleared for redistribution.

span.label: Because every main node of the four somatic sensorimotor subnetworks is reciprocally connected, sensory and motor areas can interact directly without routing through higher-order association cortex.
span.note: Quotation withheld because this record is not cleared for redistribution.

span.label: The medial subnetwork contains direct reciprocal connections between visual, auditory and primary somatosensory areas, which argues against mammalian primary sensory cortices being strictly unisensory.
span.note: Quotation withheld because this record is not cleared for redistribution.

span.label: The second medial subnetwork is a serial chain running from dorsal subiculum to RSPv to ACAv and then to the infralimbic, prelimbic and medial orbitofrontal areas.
span.note: Quotation withheld because this record is not cleared for redistribution.

span.label: Ventral retrosplenial cortex is the sole neocortical area receiving dense dorsal subicular input, making it the entry point for dorsal hippocampal information into neocortex.
span.note: Quotation withheld because this record is not cleared for redistribution.

span.label: The dorsolateral prefrontal cortex is where all four somatic sensorimotor subnetworks converge.
span.note: Quotation withheld because this record is not cleared for redistribution.

span.label: The ventromedial prefrontal cortex is where the medial and lateral subnetworks converge, letting external sensory and internal visceral/gustatory information be integrated.
span.note: Quotation withheld because this record is not cleared for redistribution.
